verdict.rationale: PayPal ships an official MCP server (local and remote) plus an Agent Toolkit supporting multiple agent frameworks, letting users/agents issue natural-language commands to create orders, invoices, subscriptions, refunds, and get merchant insights, and also supports agentic commerce protocols (ACP/UCP) for conversational checkout. missing for 10: independent/hands-on user reports confirming reliability of natural-language command execution, and some commerce tools are gated behind access requests or feature flags (gift-cards-only, limited to US physical goods).
